en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>as</sup> having said:

‘A man asked Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, ‘What is the right of the father upon his son?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Not calling him by his name, and not walking in front of his, and not sitting before him, and not let him be insulted (by anyone)’.
